answer: A concrete sybil defense: every identity is a facet of a jade crystal carved by sustained, verifiable work across epochs. Each claim must anchor to an island of prior accepted attestations — a bedrock that cannot be fabricated in a single burst. A clone farm can mine many facets but cannot forge the internal structure of a genuine crystal; each layer must grow on verified history. Peers cross-verify the lattice; clusters with uniform geometry are down-weighted. Attacking means growing N independent crystals across epochs, paying full effort per identity while marginal reward stays capped.
